conventions.command: Complete sanitized command. Placeholders: <WORKSPACE> = a git repository (or linked worktree) under $HOME, never /tmp; <CFG>/<DATA> = per-run XDG_CONFIG_HOME/XDG_DATA_HOME directories (mode 0700; <CFG>/muse/auth.json is a symlink to the operator's auth.json, never read or committed); <SESSION_UUID> = a caller-chosen random UUID; <DECK_ID>/<WORKTREE> = redacted Agent Deck deck id and worktree path. Prompts are the exact, synthetic prompt strings.
conventions.settings: Exact contents of <CFG>/muse/settings.json for that run (null = no settings.json beyond Muse defaults).
conventions.stdout_lines_raw / stdout_lines_committe: Compaction: committed fixtures drop scheduler noise events (task.lifecycle.proposed/accepted/scheduled/started, task.stream.linked, session.workspace_branch.observed, run.lifecycle.started) and, outside 01/02-tool-success/10-*, task.lifecycle.status; 09-workflow-* are tool-activity excerpts. `sequence` numbers therefore have gaps. Round-2 recaptures (10-*, 08-unreachable, 09-cron-*) were compacted the same way at capture.
conventions.exact: true when command + prompt + settings + env reproduce the run; false entries state why in exact_reason. Round-1 captures record env only as far as the round-1 harness noted (see each `env`).

cron_disable_attempts.command: cd <WORKSPACE> && env MUSE_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1 XDG_CONFIG_HOME=<CFG> XDG_DATA_HOME=<DATA> muse exec --json --no-foreign-personal-context --model muse-spark-1.3-contributor --approval-mode never --approval-judge off --sandbox-network restricted --disable-web-tools --max-model-steps 4 "Reply pong"

attempts.observed: exit 0; stderr `tbh: ignoring unknown top-level member in settings file at <CFG>/muse/settings.json: reason=unknown_member location=execution`; not enforced (execution.tool_rules is a policy-plane field only)
exit 0; stderr `muse: Named permission profiles are unavailable: missing field `schema_version``; nothing denied
exit 0; stderr `Named permission profiles are unavailable: unknown user permissions field `tool_rules``

exit 2; `--permission-profile cannot be used with --sandbox-network.` and, after removing --sandbox-network, `--permission-profile cannot be used with --approval-mode.` — a named profile cannot be combined with the unattended/sandbox flags the posture needs

cron_disable_attempts.conclusion: No per-run switch disables cron_create/cron_list/cron_delete. Attempts 1-3 are silently ignored or rejected as config; attempt 4 is mutually exclusive with the required flags; runtime_capabilities `tool:cron_create` (09-cron-disable-attempt) is accepted and ignored.

probes.setup: Started as a background job under `set -m` (own process group, pid=$!). Signal sent only after the JSONL contains `tool:bash` AND `pgrep -f 'sleep 9137'` finds the shell child (2 matches: the sandbox wrapper and sleep).
probes.command: cd <WORKSPACE> && env MUSE_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1 XDG_CONFIG_HOME=<CFG> XDG_DATA_HOME=<DATA> muse exec --json --no-foreign-personal-context --model muse-spark-1.3-contributor --approval-mode never --approval-judge off --sandbox-network restricted --disable-web-tools --session-id <SESSION_UUID> --max-model-steps 10 "Run the shell command: sleep 9137. Then reply done."   # then: kill -KILL $PID   (muse pid only)
probes.env: env MUSE_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1 XDG_CONFIG_HOME=<CFG> XDG_DATA_HOME=<DATA>
probes.stderr: (none; SIGKILL cannot be handled)
probes.notes: SIGKILL of muse alone leaves the shell child running: `pgrep -f 'sleep 9137'` = 1 afterwards (killed manually). Cancellation must be TERM/INT, or a process-group kill.
